title: Early Cancellation Charge by Year of Coverage
content:
# Early Cancellation Charge by Year of Coverage

Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda tariff. A holder's cancellation of a Kessler GAP waiver refunded on the unused part of the term carries an early cancellation charge set by the waiver's whole months in force, counted from the sale date to the request date the holder signed.

| Months in force at signing | Early cancellation charge |
|---|---|
| Fewer than 12 | 75.00 |
| 12 to 23 | 35.00 |
| 24 or more | None |

The early cancellation charge is deducted from the refund after the unused-share amount has been rounded half up to the cent. It applies whatever reason the holder stated on the request.

*Counting note.* A whole calendar month counts each time the sale date's day of the month is reached; a signing date on an earlier day of the month does not complete the month, and there is no month-end adjustment.

## Boundary Q&A (hypothetical dates)

**A waiver sold on the 5th of a month is cancelled by a request signed on the 4th of the same month a year later. Which band?** Only 11 whole months are complete: fewer than 12, so 75.00.

**Signed on the 5th of that month instead?** 12 whole months: the 12-to-23 band, so 35.00.

**Signed on the 5th of the month two years after the sale?** 24 whole months: no early cancellation charge.
